sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE finished transparent PNG gameplay sprite for a playful object-stacking mobile game. Subject: a complete white glazed CERAMIC TOILET with a friendly little pair of eyes and a small delighted smile on the side of the cistern, subtle soft pink cheek spots. The goal is a legible physical stacking silhouette with TWO HORIZONTAL SUPPORT LEVELS. Camera strictly ORTHOGRAPHIC SIDE VIEW looking at the long side; no three-quarter perspective. On the LEFT a tall rectangular water cistern with a WIDE FLAT HORIZONTAL TOP, gently bevelled corners. On the RIGHT a lower broad toilet bowl and a CLOSED FLAT LID, creating a wide horizontal low step directly beside the tall tank. No upright seat or raised cover. Under the bowl a complete stout curved pedestal narrows subtly then widens to a broad level flat foot, fully visible. The tank is physically joined to bowl and pedestal; one connected solid subject, no detached part. Outer silhouette width-to-height approximately 0.85:1.15, portrait with a tall left tank and a clear right step. Blue-tinted white porcelain, restrained cool blue rim accents, soft lavender-blue shadow faces, clean broad polished highlights and rounded thick bevels; high quality rich shaded 2.5D casual game artwork with funny personality, entertaining, not photographic, not gritty, not a flat icon. Lighting upper left, smooth dimensional ceramic glaze; material should feel premium and tactile. Image solely the entire toilet, centered, approximately 80 percent of image height with equal transparent safety margin. REAL alpha transparency, no white backdrop, no checkerboard painted into image, no floor, no cast floor shadow, no scenery, no ground plane. No text, numbers, watermark, label, border, UI, other items, detached pieces. Keep the left tall flat top and right lower flat lid clearly readable as two separate horizontal stacking surfaces. Finished production art, not a rough concept, no geometric placeholder.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE finished transparent PNG gameplay sprite for a playful object-stacking mobile game. Subject: one horizontal symmetric BLUE RUBBER-COATED DUMBBELL, complete and centered. Camera exactly ORTHOGRAPHIC SIDE VIEW, completely level, no three-quarter view, no diagonal projection. Thick cobalt and bright blue coated weight blocks of equal size at LEFT and RIGHT connected by one exposed thinner straight horizontal satin-silver metal handle. Both end weights have the SAME lowest horizontal bearing level and the SAME highest horizontal bearing level. The end weights are softly rounded square/hexagonal thick slabs with broad flat upper and lower faces and softly chamfered corners, not round spheres and not perfectly circular wheels. Thin silver metal endcaps at the two outermost sides. The center handle forms a wide open upper recess between the two raised end weights, and a matching lower recess. The whole silhouette is one solid connected continuous shape with no holes, no detached parts. Approximate total width to total height is 115:45 (about 2.55:1); each end weight about 29 percent of total width, clear exposed center handle about 38 percent, handle thickness about 28 percent of weight height. Materials polished vivid blue rubber with clean broad sky-blue beveled highlights, subtle darker blue side edges and a tactile smooth finish; silver handle satin-metal with one broad clean highlight. Rich dimensional 2.5D casual game art, high quality entertaining toy-like finish, not photographic, not gritty, not flat vector art. Soft upper-left light. No face required, no branding, no text, no numbers, no watermark. Only the entire isolated dumbbell with uniform transparent margin, REAL alpha transparent background, no solid white backdrop and no fake checkerboard, no floor or ground plane, no cast floor shadow, no UI, no other objects. Maintain a dead-level axis and matching flat foot levels so it can bridge two supports in a physics stacking game. Finished production-quality asset.
